summary: Luda Technology filed a 6-K reporting an October 13, 2026 press release: a non-binding, non-exclusive MOU with Chuluut-International LLC to evaluate acquiring 100% of transferable mining rights in Mongolia's Jonsh Tolgoi fluorspar project. No price, premium, or closing date given. The deal would diversify the NYSE American-listed steel flange maker into critical minerals and technology supply chains. No advisor or board recommendation named. Watch completion risk: the MOU is non-binding and subject to due diligence, so no arbitrage spread exists yet.
